why: Issue #925 review. The frame handler always owes the HUD its Life lost line, so the tracked player's co-op death is spoken twice, once by its toast and once by the line. The HUD's own test passes the flag by hand; only a driven frame can see the frame handler set it.
killedBy: startGameWith: a real player death reaches the HUD tells the HUD a co-op death's toast is its only sentence, unlike a single-player death (issue #925)
